Descrição
Realizar o atendimento direto a clientes, prestar suporte ao time de vendas quando solicitado, prospectar e qualificar novos leads.
Foco principal: vender e ampliar progressivamente as vendas e a satisfação do cliente, do contato inicial ao fechamento de oportunidades. Buscar sempre alcançar as metas estabelecidas.
Responsabilidades Principais
Prospecção: identificar e qualificar potenciais clientes por meio de pesquisas e ferramentas internas; realizar contato inicial com leads qualificados; apresentar nossos produtos e nossa política de prestação de serviços de pré e pós-venda.
Atendimento: realizar atendimento ativo e receptivo, via telefone, e-mail ou chat; responder consultas, dúvidas e fornecer informações detalhadas sobre os produtos e prestação de serviços de pré e pós-venda; manter contínuo relacionamento com clientes, para garantir acompanhamento adequado ao longo do processo de venda; assegurar-se de que clientes atendidos sejam indicadores de novas oportunidades
Suporte ao Time de Vendas: ter e contribuir com espírito de equipe, colaborar com o vendedor, seja interno ou externo, com envio de propostas, relatórios e atualizações de status de clientes; ter bom relacionamento com colaboradores de outros setores de pós-venda, administrativo ou de marketing; colaborar para a clareza e a facilidade dos processos de comunicação interna ou com o mercado.
Negociação e Fechamento de Vendas: não perder oportunidade de negócios, negociar condições comerciais, prazos e preços dentro das políticas da empresa; elaborar e enviar propostas comerciais clara e objetivas com foco nas necessidades dos clientes; acompanhar o processo de venda do começo ao fim, focado na satisfação do cliente.
Gestão de Carteira de Vendas: manter e gerenciar uma carteira de clientes ativa, buscar sempre novas oportunidades e novos nichos de mercado; acompanhar o pós-venda e garantir que ao suporte adequado para que sua experiência com nossos produtos e serviços seja positiva.
Atualização de CRM e Relatórios: registrar as interações e atualizações com clientes no sistema de CRM da empresa; assegurar-se da eficiência na gestão de relacionamento; gerar relatório periódico de vendas e apresentar resultados à gerência; fornecer dados objetivos e reais, colhidos no campo, para contribuir com a gestão de relacionamento e de vendas.
Cumprimento de Metas: alcançar e exceder as metas mensais e trimestrais de vendas e indicadores de desempenho; trabalhar de maneira colaborativa para maximizar resultados.
Feiras e Eventos Comerciais: participar e representar a empresa adequadamente, promover seus produtos e políticas de serviços; apoiar organização e ações de vendas e marketing, e realizar atendimentos de vendas aos clientes; coletar e qualificar leads gerados dos visitantes à feira comercial; atualizar-se sobre tendências e novidades do mercado e buscar oportunidades de networking e novos negócios.
Requisitos:
Experiência prévia em vendas internas, conhecimento e prática de telemarketing, e atendimento ao cliente. Experiência no ramo Odontológico será um diferencial.
Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita e habilidades financeira durante negociação para fechamento de negócios.
Proatividade, capacidade de geração de demandas, organização e capacidade de trabalhar com metas, ter resiliência e flexibilidade para atuar sob pressão do mercado.
É desejável que tenha, também, familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, pacote Office e capacidade de aprender rapidamente novos softwares.

Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe.
Perfil consultivo, focado em entender as necessidades do cliente.
Capacidade de lidar com metas e prazos.
Alta capacidade de organização e planejamento.

  25. Perform other duties as required.

  6. Equipment operating experience.

  10. Consolidate and lab pack wastes as required per profile and classification.
  11. Safely operate various pieces of equipment on station (Skytrax, ATVs, etc.).
  12. Store processed hazardous wastes according to segregation requirements.
  13. Keep waste inventory records updated and accurate.
  14. Perform quality-assurance checks on inventory database and files.

  16. Act as Spill Team Lead for entire station, write spill reports, and conduct trainings and drills.
  17. Organize, orient, and train members of Spill Team for outside spill response. Coordinate with staff of the visiting vessels as applicable.
  18. Maintain inventory of spill supplies in the two spill-vans and satellite spill kits.
  19. Assist station mechanic with weekly station fueling activities.
  20. Maintain/deploy spill-boom supplies for station fueling.
  21. Assist with general station needs, including snow removal, radio communications on assigned day, mini-GASH, GASH, and House Mouse activities.

  25. Maintain a flexible schedule based on Vessel Operations, unusual hours, and other station-wide activities.
  26. Ensure seasonal replacement receives proper training and maintain a log of this information.
  27. Troubleshoot any issues that arise and elevate them as needed.
  28. Supply manual labor (shoveling) for several hours if needed.
  29. Perform regular use of drum dollies, cargo straps, banding, shovels, pallet jacks, power tools, and other tools.
  30. Perform regular physical activity, including bending, consistently lifting and carrying, reaching, and gripping.
  31. Display self-motivation in physically challenging and atypical work environment; position is comprised of approximately 70% outdoor tasking.
  32. Maintain flexibility and positive attitude in a dynamic, fast-paced work setting.
  33. Perform duties in support of Operations Division metrics (as provided by supervisor).
  34. Support the achievement of ASC metrics, whether metrics are directly or indirectly affected by this position's work activities.
  35. Comply with all ASC Environmental Health & Safety, and Quality Assurance, requirements and goals. Provide documentation to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.
  36. Work to achieve ASC goals and contractual commitments.
  37. Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace and ensuring that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  38. Perform other duties as required.
  39. Reports to Hazardous Waste Manager and Solid Waste Manager.

REQUIREMENTS:

  1. 2 years (or Antarctic seasons) of USAP Waste Management experience.
  2. College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).
  3. Strong computer software experience.
  4. Able to lift 50 pounds consistently and wear a respirator.
  5. Valid Driver's License and Passport valid for six months after contract end.
  6. Physically able to be active for 9 hours daily.
  7. Must be able to lift the safety regulation maximum.
  8. Must pass physical qualification assessment.
  9. Able to deploy to Antarctica for length of contract.

PREFERRED:

  1. 1 year of Hazardous Materials shipping/characterization or reporting experience or 2 years of Environmental remediation.
  2. 1 year of supervisory experience.
  3. 1 year of High School Chemistry or equivalent.
  4. 1 quarter of college General Chemistry.
  5. College degree in Chemistry or Environmental Science.
  6. OSHA HazWOPER 40-Hour, current.
  7. Familiarity with power tools and machinery.
  8. Equipment operating experience.
  9. Previous management or supervisory experience.

EDUCATION: College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).

CERTIFICATIONS AND/OR LICENSING REQUIREMENTS: Valid Driver's License and passport valid for six months after end of contract.

OTHER: US citizenship or permanent residency required.

description:
About World Business Lenders ( )

World Business Lenders (WBL) provides short-term, real estate collateralized commercial loans to small and medium-sized businesses across the United States that lack access to traditional funding. WBL manages its own loan portfolio and third-party portfolios, specializing in non-performing loan pools and REO.

WBL is a U.S.-based company with a fully remote workforce.

This is a remote contract/consultant position with working hours from 9:00 am to 6:00 pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

The role requires excellent command of written and spoken English. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Position Summary

The Asset Resolution Team Lead (also known as Case Management Team Lead) manages an assigned portfolio of distressed short-term, real estate collateralized commercial loans. They provide mentorship and support to Asset Resolution Analysts (ARAs), each managing their own distressed loan portfolios. The Team Lead is responsible for portfolio ownership, case analysis, recovery operations, and working with outside counsel to optimize asset resolution.

Key responsibilities include developing and monitoring collection, loss mitigation, and recovery strategies in collaboration with outside counsel, managing case administration, analysis, and reporting.

This leadership role requires managing a large asset portfolio, providing clear instructions to external parties, familiarity with legal proceedings (preferably in the U.S.), and financial analysis skills or experience in structured finance. Candidates should be comfortable with leadership duties and mentoring junior staff.

Essential Functions

  • Manage and monitor a non-performing real estate collateralized commercial loan portfolio.
  • Develop, train, and supervise a team of Asset Resolution Analysts.
  • Develop and update policies and procedures.
  • Conduct pipeline management and financial analysis.
  • Implement recovery strategies.
  • Oversee litigation, bankruptcy, and foreclosure activities, including drafting and reviewing legal documents.
  • Liaise with attorneys, collection agencies, and vendors.
  • Engage with customers and their counsel for negotiations and conflict resolution.
  • Maintain accurate case records.
  • Prepare reports on case status, performance, outcomes, budgets, and forecasts.
  • Collaborate on financial reporting, valuations, and legal strategies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent (preferred from U.S. institution).
  • Paralegal Certificate or equivalent (preferred).
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Knowledge of U.S. collection, foreclosure, bankruptcy laws, and legal processes.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
Why the American University of Iraq—Baghdad?
Opening its doors in January 2021, the new American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. With a great library, palatial college buildings and student centers, state-of-the-art classrooms, laboratories, and athletic facilities, AUIB will be a beautiful campus, attracting students, faculty, and staff from throughout the world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

Job Summary

The Facilities Manager is responsible for strategic and operational team-oriented leadership of the physical plant while working collaboratively with third-party service providers that provide services to the university. The Facilities Manager plans, leads, and coordinates the construction of campus facilities with third-party providers, including facility renewal, maintenance, and repair.

Responsibilities

The primary core responsibilities, as indicated below:

  • Develop long- and short-term plans for the construction, renovation, repair, and maintenance of physical plants, collaborating with third-party service providers.
  • Coordinate with third-party service providers to ensure that renovations, repairs, and maintenance are completed in a timely manner and that facilities are in excellent working order.
  • Serve as the university’s representative during the construction of major campus infrastructure projects.
  • Provide guidance and advice on the development of the university’s physical plant.
  • Provide schedule reports and other feedback as necessary on the progress of construction, renovations, repairs, and maintenance.
  • Support the use of technology to enhance operations, improve the campus infrastructure, and reduce energy costs.
  • Ensure projects are completed on schedule, within budget, and comply with applicable codes and regulations.
  • Provide formal and informal training programs as needed to provide relevant knowledge and skills to plant personnel.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related study, with a preference for a Master’s degree.
  • Five years’ demonstrated experience leading small to large projects.
  • A proven record of leadership in facilities management with budget experience.
  • The ability to lead with both a decisive and consultative style, foster open communications, and proactively build positive relationships.
  • A track record of overseeing the complex construction of campus facilities.
  • A team player who fosters collaboration across the organization and has a commitment to excellence.
  • Physical capacity for prolonged standing, walking and climbing stairs with exposure to outdoor elements.

Required

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.
  • Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Please provide an up-to-date resume or CV.
  • Identification: A valid national ID or passport is required for the application process.
  • Please note that applications missing any of these components will not be considered.

Shortlisted Candidates

If you are shortlisted for an interview, you will need to provide additional documentation:

  • Educational transcripts and certifications must be translated into English.
  • References: You must provide contact details for three references. These individuals should be those who have either worked with you or supervised your work.

We look forward to receiving your complete applications and appreciate your interest in joining our dynamic team at AUIB.

Aircraft Mechanic II (Engine)

The Aircraft Mechanic II (Engine) repairs, services, and troubleshoots malfunctions on aircraft engine systems (T-700GE-700 or T-55-L-714).

  • Remove and install aircraft engines and engine components.
  • Service and lubricate aircraft and subsystems.

  • Perform scheduled inspections and assist in performing special inspections.
  • Perform limited maintenance operational checks and diagnose and troubleshoot aircraft engine systems using special tools and test equipment as required.
  • Use and perform operator maintenance on tools, special tools, and aircraft ground support equipment.
  • Apply comprehensive technical expertise to solve moderate to complex problems by interpreting technical documentation such as aircraft Technical Manuals, Maintenance Information and Action Messages, and all technical guidance provided through government official representatives.
  • Maintain and repair aircraft engine components.
  • Apply technical knowledge of aircraft engine systems in determining equipment malfunctions and use required expertise in restoring equipment condition and/or operation.
  • Participate in maintenance test flights and operation checks as required.
  • Perform other duties as requested.

Minimum Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • U.S. military technical school or specialized training course is desired, certification of education level is required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years aviation maintenance experience within the last five (5) years on T-700GE-700 Series engines and/or T-55-L-714 engines.
  • Or A&P license and two (2) years aviation maintenance experience within the last five (5) years on T-700-GE-701 Series engines and/or T-55-L-714 engines.
  • Must be in possession of a U.S. Passport with minimum 2 plus year validity and 6 blank pages, and be able to travel internationally.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain facility Public Trust NAC-I. Note: US Citizenship is required for facility Public Trust NAC-I at this work location.
  • Must be able to obtain Iraq Visa.
  • Must be able to pass CENTCOM Medical requirements for deployment.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Thorough knowledge of aircraft mechanical component troubleshooting, repair procedures, and replacement of parts.
  • Thorough knowledge of aircraft unique tools such as test equipment, torque wrenches, dial indicators, and micrometers.
  • Working knowledge of technical publications and Logistics Information Systems.
  • Able to prioritize workloads to maintain schedules on assigned projects.
  • Participate in maintenance test flights and operation checks as required.
  • Able to lead teams through more complex aircraft relevant tasks.
  • Possess the level of experience to inspect all required aeronautical type maintenance to be performed by Mechanics.
  • The incumbent receives technical guidance, as required, from supervisor or higher-level technician, and may be required to make entries in aircraft logs and records.

Physical Requirements/Working Environment

  • Must be able to walk and stand on level and/or inclined surfaces for extended periods throughout the day.
  • Must be able to climb stairs, ramps, ladders, and work stands.
  • Must be able to crouch, crawl, grasp or handle objects, use finger dexterity, bend elbow/knee and reach above/below shoulders.
  • May be required to lift heavy objects whose weight may exceed 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to type using a standard keyboard to communicate through e-mail and various software applications.
  • Will handle dirty parts and lubricants.
  • Will be required to wear proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
  • Must be able to pass a Respirator Physical and Fit Test qualification.
  • May be required to operate power vehicles, machinery, hand tools, ground support equipment, fork lift, etc.
  • Must be able to lift/push/pull minimum of 50 pounds.
  • May work in maintenance shop or outside.
  • Must be able to work in a shop where the environment is drafty, noisy, and dirty.
  • May be exposed to extreme noise from operating equipment.
  • May be exposed to electrical shock hazards or work near moving mechanical parts or vehicles.
  • May be expected to work in austere environments and all weather conditions.

description:
Join to apply for the ENFERMEIRO - PRONTO SOCORRO role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. A rede de atenção às urgências e emergências se caracteriza pela rápida resposta aos quadros agudos de natureza clínica ou traumática que ocorrem fora do ambiente hospitalar. É fundamental para garantir suporte e a sobrevivência das pessoas vitimadas por quadros de maior gravidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Prestar assistência segura, humanizada e individualizada, desde a admissão até a transferência de setor, sob supervisão do enfermeiro;
  • Verificar sinais vitais, administrar medicações e realizar procedimentos assistenciais, sempre com foco na segurança e na redução de riscos de infecção;
  • Preencher registros específicos relacionados à assistência e prontuário, conforme normas institucionais e orientação do enfermeiro;
  • Garantir a adequada comunicação entre as equipes durante o plantão;
  • Preparar e prover materiais, equipamentos e insumos necessários para os procedimentos, zelando pela correta utilização e conservação;
  • Auxiliar o médico e prestar suporte na realização de exames e cuidados específicos do paciente;
  • Monitorar o posicionamento de cateteres, sondas e drenos, reportando irregularidades ao enfermeiro;
  • Cumprir as normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem e as rotinas institucionais;
  • Realizar procedimentos dentro das técnicas assépticas e seguir orientações do Serviço de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar;
  • Demais atividades pertinentes a função.
Requisitos e qualificações:
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Pós-graduação completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Urgência/Emergência (Pronto Socorro), UTI ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Enfermeiro em urgência/emergência.
Informações adicionais:
  • Atuação na região de Diadema na escala 12x36.
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Data & Technology: to implement major transformation projects.
Cloud & Application Services: to build or integrate software solutions.
Service Centers of Excellence: to support the latter through technology, innovation, agility, sustainability of skills and cost optimization.

Talan accelerates its clients' transformation through innovation and technology. By understanding their challenges, with our support, innovation, technology and data, we enable them to be more efficient and resilient.

We believe that only a human-oriented practice of technology will make the new digital age an era of progress for all. Together let's commit!

Job Description

Main Tasks:

  • As an observability specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, availability, and performance of our organization's systems and services.
  • Collaborate with development and operations teams to understand the requirements for observability and monitoring of their services.
  • You will work closely with our development and operations teams to design, implement, and maintain monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions that enable us to identify and resolve issues quickly.
  • Enable and leverage the observability practice.
  • Act as a fellow squad member.
  • Promote and leverage the near-zero manual actions in the administration and upgrade of systems, together with the development of incident automatic responses.

  • Leverage the monitoring processes so they map the underlying business processes they support.
  • Ensure that observability and monitoring systems are set up to provide actionable insights that can be used to improve system stability, performance, and availability.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to observability systems, including data quality, system availability, and performance.
  • Continuously evaluate new and emerging observability technologies and tools, and make recommendations for their adoption.
  • Develop and maintain documentation on observability systems and procedures.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

  • Solid knowledge in public clouds: AWS, Azure, GCP.
  • Experience with tools such as Dynatrace (Required), Netcool, Devo, Netscout, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Jaeger, etc.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and containerization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience in dealing with large data sets.
  • Basic knowledge about Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence applications.
  • Proficient in English language.
  • Understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts.

Additional Information

What do we offer you?

  • Permanent, full-time contract.
  • Smart Office Pack so that you can work comfortably from home.
  • Training and career development.
  • Benefits and perks such as private medical insurance, life insurance, lunch and travel cards as part of the flexible remuneration package.
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.
  • Hybrid position, based in Málaga. Relocation is mandatory.
  • Possibility to manage work permits.

Kaizen Gaming, the team powering Betano, is one of the biggest GameTech companies in the world, operating in 17 markets.

We always aim to leverage cutting-edge technology, providing the best experience to our millions of customers who trust us for their entertainment.

We are a diverse team of more than 2,700 Kaizeners, from 40+ nationalities spreading across 3 continents. Our #oneteam is proud to be among the Best Workplaces in Europe and certified Great Place to Work across our offices. Here, there’ll be no average day for you. Ready to Press Play on Potential?

Let's start with the role

You will join an autonomous Agile team and work closely with the Product Owner, Agile Delivery Lead, Automation Testers, and other Software Engineers to create a competitive advantage for Kaizen and offer a unique online experience to our customers. Besides being part of the Agile team, you will work closely with talented backend professionals within the Backend Chapter.

As a Senior Software Engineer you will:

  • Assume full responsibility for our applications on an engaging development journey.
  • Create new solutions and see them through, from conception to production.
  • Turn requirements into simple and sophisticated technological systems. Our large scale, highly available infrastructure is at the core of that challenge.
  • Play a central role in designing, building, and maintaining efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
  • Research new technologies to find new and efficient ways to solve day-to-day challenges.
  • Challenge the status quo and improve the team and product.

Most of our sites and services are written in C# / ASP.NET and new services are written in .NET Core. New applications use vue.js or Angular in the front-end while older ones use server-rendered (Razor) views in combination with jQuery. Microsoft Orleans enables our scalable and robust distributed applications. MS SQL Server is used for most of our storage needs, but also Redis and ElasticSearch are used when it makes sense to do so. RabbitMQ is our go-to message broker. We use Gitlab for code versioning and CI, and the Atlassian stack for tickets and documentation.

What you'll bring:

  • Proficient in C# and MVC.
  • Experience with Testing/Metrics Monitoring/Logging on a large scale distributed system.
  • Experience with Microservices architecture.
  • Experience with asynchronous flows using message brokers.
  • Good understanding of basic web technologies, such as HTTP, REST, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of algorithms and design patterns.
  • Passionate about delivering high-quality code.
  • Fluent in English, both oral and written.

Nice to have:

  • Expertise in concurrency, multi-threading, and event-driven architecture.

Location: Hybrid way of working & remote options.

A buddy will support you with your onboarding.

Private health insurance for you & your family.

Monthly meal allowance.

Nice Rigs - 2.5K monitor, latest i7, tons of RAM, fast SSD.

Unlimited access to Udemy & continuous training.

Commuting allowance.

RINA is currently recruiting for a Senior Environmental Consultant to join its office in São Paulo within the Sustainability and Business Innovation Division .

Mission

The Senior Environmental Consultant focuses on leading and overseeing the assessment and mitigation of environmental risks associated with energy, infrastructure, and industrial projects. They deliver permitting-related services, conduct environmental studies, environmental monitoring and modeling, compliance assessments, due diligence, and audits to evaluate compliance with Italian and European regulations or Project Financing standards. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

  1. Lead Environmental Impact Assessment Studies:
  • Lead and oversee comprehensive environmental impact assessments for energy, infrastructure, and industrial projects, analyzing factors such as air quality, water resources, and biodiversity.
  • Provide strategic guidance and technical expertise in conducting environmental studies to facilitate permitting and authorization processes, identifying potential risks and mitigation measures.
  • Environmental and Social Due Diligences, Studies, and Audits:
    • Lead due diligence assessments to evaluate environmental and social risks associated with projects, ensuring thorough analysis and identification of potential impacts.
    • Oversee audits to ensure compliance with environmental regulations, social standards, and financial requirements, providing recommendations for improvement.
  • Analysis of Pollutant Dispersion and Deposition:
    • Utilize advanced modeling techniques to simulate pollutant dispersion from energy facilities, evaluating potential impacts on air quality, water bodies, and soil.
    • Lead assessments of deposition patterns and concentrations of pollutants to estimate environmental effects and risks, providing expert recommendations for mitigation.
  • Develop Tailored Mitigation Strategies:
    • Lead the development of tailored mitigation strategies to address environmental and social risks, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
    • Collaborate closely with project teams to integrate mitigation measures into project plans and financing agreements, providing technical guidance and oversight.
  • Collaboration with Interdisciplinary Teams:
    • Work closely with engineers, economists, legal advisors, and other professionals to analyze data and assess project feasibility, providing expert input on environmental considerations throughout the project lifecycle.
    • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior consultants, fostering a collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Prepare Comprehensive Reports:
    • Lead the compilation and analysis of environmental data to prepare detailed reports for stakeholders, including investors, financiers, and regulatory authorities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with reporting standards.
    • Effectively communicate findings, risks, and mitigation strategies to support Project Financing activities and client decision-making processes.
  • Support Proposal Preparation and Client Liaison:
    • Assist in preparing project proposals and financing documents, including environmental sections and risk assessments, providing expert input and guidance.
    • Engage proactively with clients and stakeholders to understand requirements and address environmental concerns during project development and financing negotiations, building strong client relationships.
  • International Travel and Site Visits:
    • Travel internationally as required to conduct site visits and assess environmental, health, safety, and social aspects of projects, providing expert oversight and guidance.
    • Review and monitor environmental documentation, compliance measures, and project implementation on-site, ensuring adherence to environmental standards and requirements.
  • Project Management Support:
    • Provide leadership and support for project management tasks, including monitoring budgets, schedules, and milestones, ensuring timely delivery of environmental deliverables and compliance with financing requirements.

    Qualifications

    • Demonstrated track record of successfully leading comprehensive environmental impact assessments for energy, infrastructure, and industrial projects.
    • Proven experience (8+ years) in environmental assessment methodologies and compliance with project financing environmental and social standards.
    • Expertise in utilizing advanced modeling techniques for pollutant dispersion and deposition patterns.
    • In-depth understanding and application of IFC Performance standards as well as ADB/EBRD/Equator Principles or other international Lenders’ Environmental, social, health and safety standards, in the context of infrastructure and/or energy sectors.
    • Ability to perform air quality modeling and/or noise quality modeling, ability to use Windpro to undertake shadow flicker, noise, and visual impact assessments.
    • Experience in developing tailored mitigation strategies to address environmental and social risks, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
    • Strong background in collaborating with interdisciplinary teams, providing expert input on environmental considerations throughout the project lifecycle.

    Education

    • Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental Science or Engineering
    • Master’s Degree in Environmental Engineering

Our customers create mission-critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.

They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs.   • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Quality Engineer at Tractian, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the highest quality standards for our hardware products and solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including design, manufacturing, and quality assurance, to ensure that our products meet rigorous quality requirements and exceed customer expectations. Additionally, you will be responsible for identifying and collaborating with suppliers who share our commitment to excellence, further enhancing our supply chain efficiency and ensuring the consistent quality of the materials used in our products. Your expertise will contribute significantly to our mission of delivering exceptional IIoT solutions to industries worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the design and manufacturing teams to define quality standards, specifications, and inspection criteria for mechanical components and assemblies.
  • Conduct thorough quality assessments of incoming materials, ensuring they meet specified requirements and are free from defects.
  • Develop and implement quality control processes, including inspection plans, testing procedures, and relevant documentation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and corrective actions for any quality issues identified during testing or production, and track these actions to closure.
  • Participate in the design review process to provide insights on potential quality concerns and ensure design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM and DFA).
  • Conduct regular audits of manufacturing processes to identify opportunities for improvement and ensure adherence to quality standards.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to improve component quality, resolve quality-related issues, and drive continuous improvement in the supply chain.
  • Work closely with the production team to support process validation and ensure consistency in manufacturing processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of quality assurance activities, including test results, inspection reports, and non-conformance documentation.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of quality documentation, including standard operating procedures, work instructions, and quality manuals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Quality Engineer, preferably in a manufacturing or technology-driven environment.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles, materials, and manufacturing processes.
  • Familiarity in quality tools, methodologies, and documentation such as 8D, DMAIC, NCR, EA, and statistical process control.
  • Experience with inspection techniques, metrology, GD&T, and non-destructive testing methods.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to lead root cause analysis investigations.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or other quality management systems is a plus.
  • Reading and Writing English proficiency.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with microcasting and sintering.
  • Experience with plastic injection and mold manufacturing.
  • Strong understanding of Reliability Engineering and its tools.
  • Spanish proficiency.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Day off during the week of your birthday
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

• Acompanhar, interpretar e agir rapidamente com ações efetivas, através dos dados informados pelo laboratório, que estarão disponíveis no sistema.

  1. Estar presencialmente na estação de coleta. Amazon lidera operações 24-7, e portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função, podendo incluir finais de semana e feriados.
  2. Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança em sua área de trabalho.

  10. Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade.

Expertise na concepção de propostas técnicas, condução de apresentações e demonstrações de produtos de Segurança, evidenciando uma abordagem proativa e eficaz.

About Us
Chainlink Labs is the primary contributing developer of Chainlink, the decentralized computing platform powering the verifiable web. Chainlink is the industry-standard platform for providing access to real-world data, offchain computation, and secure cross-chain interoperability across any blockchain. Chainlink Labs helps power verifiable applications for banking, DeFi, global trade, and gaming by collaborating with some of the world’s largest financial institutions, notably Swift, DTCC, and ANZ. Chainlink Labs also works with top Web3 teams, including Aave, Compound, GMX, Maker, and Synthetix. Chainlink Labs was ranked in Newsweek’s 100 Most Loved Workplaces 2023 in both the United States and United Kingdom.

Chainlink decentralized oracle networks provide tamper-proof inputs, outputs, and computations to support advanced smart contracts on any blockchain. As the ecosystem continues to grow rapidly, we are building infrastructure to further secure the reliability of our networks and incentivize good behavior.

Your Responsibilities

  1. Support and lead a team of up to eight engineers to build the on-chain billing and payments protocol within the Chainlink ecosystem.

Preferred Skills

description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What will you do

As a Hardware Test Engineer specializing in Mechanics, your primary role will involve conducting rigorous mechanical testing and validation on a variety of hardware products. You will be hands-on in the lab, applying principles of mechanics to assess durability, lifespan, and functionality, ensuring all mechanical components operate effectively under specified conditions and comply with all regulatory standards.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute detailed mechanical test plans, including stress tests, vibration tests, and thermal cycling to evaluate product endurance.
  • Use precision measuring instruments such as calipers, micrometers, and force gauges to gather accurate test data.
  • Simulate real-world mechanical stresses using test rigs, hydraulic actuators, and environmental chambers.
  • Analyze test results, identify mechanical failures, and collaborate with design engineers to recommend product improvements.
  • Maintain meticulous documentation of all testing procedures, results, and insights for future reference and compliance purposes.
  • Ensure all mechanical testing equipment is calibrated, maintained, and operating correctly.
  • Stay up-to-date with the mechanical testing methodologies and industry best practices.
,

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in a mechanical testing environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of mechanical systems, materials properties, and manufacturing processes.
  • Proficiency in CAD software, such as SolidWorks or AutoCAD, for reviewing mechanical designs.
  • Experience with scripting languages, like Python and MATLAB.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis software like Excel.
  • Familiarity with industry standards for mechanical testing and compliance.
,

Bonus Points

  • Advanced certifications in mechanical testing or material science.
  • Experience with automated testing systems and robotic testing equipment.
  • Fluent in English.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Quer entrar ou migrar para o mercado financeiro, ajudando pessoas a alcançar seus objetivos de vida? Esta é a sua oportunidade, #SejaRaiz!

SOBRE A BRAÚNA

Fundada em 2015, a Braúna surgiu do sonho de profissionais com extensa experiência no mercado financeiro de criar uma empresa com um serviço diferenciado na maneira do cliente investir. Com alinhamento de interesses e visão de longo prazo, nosso objetivo é oferecer o melhor serviço, os melhores produtos e criar o mais completo e eficiente ecossistema de negócios do Brasil, com soluções para o mercado nacional e internacional. Deste sonho, temos acima de R$9 bilhões sob custódia e mais de 200 sócios alinhados com o ideal “Cliente em Primeiro Lugar”.

RESPONSABILIDADE E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Programa Seja Raiz:

O Seja Raiz é um programa de 6 meses, dividido em 2 fases, onde o/a trainee se desenvolverá para se especializar na área de maior sinergia.

1º Fase (3 meses):

  • Treinamentos comerciais para qualificação no atendimento a clientes.
  • Treinamentos técnicos sobre diversos produtos financeiros: investimentos, seguros de vida, consórcio, financiamento, planejamento financeiro pessoal, créditos, produtos PJs, câmbio, entre outros.
  • Responsabilidades:
    • Prospecção de clientes;
    • Mapeamento e estruturação da carteira de clientes;
    • Desenvolvimento de estratégias financeiras adequadas ao perfil dos clientes;
    • Apresentação de soluções financeiras;
    • Construção de relacionamento com os clientes;
    • Atualização sobre tendências do mercado financeiro

2º Fase (3 meses):

  • Avaliações para tomada de decisão para qual área o/a trainee tem maior sinergia: assessoria de investimentos, planejamento financeiro, aquisição de bens, planejamento patrimonial, áreas operacionais ou especialização em produtos financeiros específicos (renda variável, fixa, câmbio, FIIs, etc).
  • Treinamentos específicos para se tornar um especialista na área escolhida.

3º Fase:

  • Conclusão dos 6 meses com formatura.
  • Avaliações de desempenho e comportamental.
  • Início da jornada na Braúna em uma nova área.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Interesse na área comercial;
  • Ensino superior completo ou no último ano (qualquer área);
  • Morar em Campinas ou região;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpesssoal;
  • Diferenciais: Experiência no mercado financeiro e certificações (CPA-10/ CPA-20/ CEA/ CFP);
  • Gostar de desafios.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

  • Programa de incentivos financeiros;
  • Acesso a plataformas de capacitação exclusivas da Braúna;
  • Possibilidade de acesso ao Total Pass.

E você? Gostou da ideia? Se inscreva em nosso processo seletivo para te conhecermos melhor. #VemSerBraúna ?

description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a Character Art Director to join our growing team on Fortnite. This person will lead and collaborate with multidisciplinary artists to help create and maintain Epic's vision. This person will have a balance of creative thinking and a strong ability to lead a team in developing content for our various projects. By working closely with the Senior Art Director, you will be accountable for identifying and communicating a high-quality visual style, as well as developing a team of artists and coaching them to do the same.

In this role, you will

  • Be highly creative. Imagine and communicate your vision to the team to develop new content that players will love.
  • Lead Art initiatives, working closely with other non-Art Teams including Design, Engineering, Product, and Marketing.
  • Strategize with Senior Leadership to help define the Art Team's direction and priorities.
  • Create and iterate unique and stunning character designs within a determined production schedule.
  • Direct and mentor a worldwide team of artists; delivering effective feedback across all art disciplines - modeling, animation, etc.
  • Collaborate with the Product and IP teams on themes and cosmetic sets.
  • Deliver effective feedback across all art disciplines - modeling, animation, etc.

What we're looking for

  • Experience as an art director with a character design background and understanding of the 2D and 3D process in a game studio.
  • A deep understanding of the game development process and art disciplines.
  • Experience with working with Product Management on new initiatives.
  • Solid technical background in art and game development.
  • Practical experience using Unreal.
  • Strong leadership skills in order to lead a large number of people toward a singular vision.
  • Strong collaborative nature to partner with senior art directors and discipline leads.
  • Strong understanding of art fundamentals, multiple art styles, anatomy, appeal, color theory, and how color affects mood & focal points - with a focus on modern fashion-forward aesthetics.
  • Experience designing characters of a wide variety with broad appeal and the ability to adapt to and innovate new styles and techniques.
  • Experience directing and supporting artists across multiple disciplines.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, but it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Sobre a Charles River Associates:

A Charles River Associates tem sido, há mais de 50 anos, uma empresa pioneira de consultoria que oferece aos funcionários um lugar para colaborar e aprender com um grupo diversificado de consultores, especialistas do setor e acadêmicos. Na CRA, você se juntará a mentes líderes que usam análises econômicas, financeiras, técnicas e de negócios para resolver problemas complexos para uma lista impressionante de clientes, incluindo 99% dos 100 maiores escritórios de advocacia, 89% das empresas da Fortune 100 e agências governamentais em todo o mundo. A CRA oferece um ambiente colaborativo, com equipes que buscam a excelência do cliente, trazendo curiosidade, desenvoltura e iniciativa ao seu trabalho. Através de um ambiente colegiado, oportunidades formais e informais de treinamento e uma ampla gama de recursos de desenvolvimento profissional, sua experiência na CRA abrirá portas para você à medida que você acelera sua carreira.

Visão geral do trabalho

Como Associado ou Consultor Associado, você apoiará a equipe sênior na realização de avaliações de risco de Compliance, investigações contábeis forenses, pesquisa e análise de grande volume de dados. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com colegas no Brasil, nos Estados Unidos e na Europa, mas será fundamentalmente responsável pelo trabalho executado pela companhia do Brasil.

Você será responsável por trabalhar em atribuições de pesquisa, investigações financeiras, litígios e questões de disputa. As responsabilidades podem incluir (mas não se limitam a):

  • Investigar e analisar registros financeiros e contábeis em apoio a diversas investigações financeiras, como apropriação indébita de ativos, corrupção ou fraude nas demonstrações financeiras.
  • Realizar procedimentos contábeis forenses como parte de grandes investigações multidisciplinares que incorporam investigações tradicionais de pesquisas de antecedentes, conjuntos de dados complexos e análises técnicas contábeis ou econômicas.
  • Utilizar históricos econômico, contábil e/ou financeiro para apoiar especialistas seniores.
  • Preparar e apresentar materiais em relação às propostas e reuniões dos clientes.
  • Participar de iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios e desenvolvimento de práticas.

  • Auxiliar na criação, desenvolvimento e controle de qualidade das entregas de clientes, incluindo análises financeiras, resumos de pesquisas, laudos periciais e outros materiais.

Qualificações

Estamos buscando candidatos para apoiar nossas crescentes ofertas de investigações. Os candidatos ideais devem possuir:

  • 2-4 anos de experiência de trabalho relevante em contabilidade forense ou área relacionada.
  • Fluência em português e inglês é obrigatória, pois essa pessoa interagirá frequentemente com escritórios internacionais.
  • Graduação em disciplinas relacionadas, como administração, direito ou contabilidade, com experiência prévia de consultoria sendo preferencial. Certificações profissionais são favoráveis, mas não necessárias.
  • Vontade de trabalhar em um ambiente empreendedor.
  • Habilidades analíticas, quanto a resolução de problemas e ótima comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Capacidade de priorizar várias tarefas, gerenciar vários fluxos de trabalho, estar atento aos detalhes e cumprir prazos.
  • Alto nível de iniciativa e curiosidade, ética de trabalho e dedicação à qualidade.

Como Associado ou Consultor Associado, você terá contato frequente com a liderança sênior e trabalhará em colaboração com os membros da sua equipe.

Now is the perfect time to join us and help accomplish our mission. If you’re inspired by purpose, thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment, and are ready to shape the future of payments, we’d love to hear from you!

About the role

We are seeking a skilled and go-getter Sr. Machine Learning Engineer to join our Data Science team and play a pivotal role in driving the model development/production lifecycle. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, MLOps, and DataOps teams to implement ML models for assessing transactional risk and fraud, enable automated model retraining, and support robust machine learning inference systems. This role is essential for ensuring efficient, reliable, and scalable workflows to power data-driven insights and machine learning solutions.


What you will do:

  • Model Development and Optimization: Design the data-architecture flow for the efficient implementation of real-time model endpoints and/or batch solutions.

  • Productionization of ML Models: Build pipelines to deploy machine learning models in production with a focus on scalability and efficiency, and participate in and enforce the release management process for models and rules.
  • Monitoring, Maintenance & Improvement: Implement systems to monitor model performance, endpoints/feature health, and other business metrics; Create model-retraining pipelines to boost performance, based on monitoring metrics; Model recalibration.
  • Scalable System Design: Design and implement scalable architectures to support real-time/batch solutions; Optimize algorithms and workflows for latency, throughput, and resource efficiency; Ensure systems adhere to company standards for reliability and security.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Conduct research and prototypes to explore novel approaches in ML engineering for addressing emerging risk/fraud patterns.
  • Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with fraud analysts, risk managers, and product teams to translate business requirements into ML solutions.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in CS/Engineering/Data-Science or other technical disciplines.
  • Solid experience in DS/ML engineering.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Hands-on experience in implementing batch and real-time streaming pipelines, using SQL and NoSQL database solutions.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools for data pipelines, streaming systems, and model performance.
  • Experience in AWS cloud services (Sagemaker, EC2, EMR, ECS/EKS, RDS, etc.).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation), and MLOps platforms like MLflow.
  • Experience with Machine Learning modeling, notably tree-based and boosting models supervised learning for imbalanced target scenarios.
  • Experience with Online Inference, APIs, and services that respond under tight time constraints.
  • Proficiency in English.

    • Prior experience with ML applied to financial decision-making, such as credit risk, and fraud prevention.
    • Prior experience with AWS Sagemaker and/or similar DS/ML workbench.
    • Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
    • Feature store development and integration experience.
    • Experience with distributed data systems such as Kafka, Spark, Hadoop, and workflow/data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow).

title: Account Manager, Global Selling DSR (Direct Seller Recruiting), Amazon Global Selling
description:
Account Manager, Global Selling DSR (Direct Seller Recruiting), Amazon Global Selling

Are you looking for a challenging career in business-development? Do you have prior experience and a proven track-record in delivering against targets in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? Amazon is looking for a Global Selling Account Managers to join its team based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
Your role will be focused on contributing to new business acquisition (50% of the time) through hunting, specifically phone/email-based prospecting of new merchants who can bring their competitive range of products, pricing and availability to Amazon. You will also work with merchants as an account manager (50% of the time) – helping them to launch and grow their business on Amazon by ensuring they understand Amazon’s products, services, systems and tools. Lastly you will be responsible for using feedback from the merchants to identify opportunities to improve Amazon’s products, services, processes, systems and tools.
Key job responsibilities
- Identify, prospect and recruit high-potential merchants via phone or email
- Effectively prioritize and manage a pipeline of merchants to consistently meet/exceed quarterly targets
- Be a business partner for new merchants providing them with data-driven insights and advice to optimize their success on Amazon
- Work closely with new merchants, educating them about Amazon’s high standards of Delivery and Customer Experience
- Enable merchants to learn and master Amazon's tools and systems so they may become self-sufficient in managing their catalog, inventory and performance efficiently and to the required standards
- Learn and understand the specificities of your categories to spot trends, seasonal items and competitive pricing to best tailor your pitch and advice to merchants
- Track and report business development results, analyze, interpret reports and information for your portfolio of merchants
- Prioritize your time optimally to achieve your targets in a KPI-driven environment
A day in the life
A typical day begins with reviewing performance metrics and pipeline status before diving into proactive outreach to potential merchants. Throughout the morning, you'll conduct virtual meetings with new sellers, providing comprehensive onboarding support and guidance through Amazon's Seller Central platform. The afternoon focuses on analyzing merchant data, conducting business reviews, and offering strategic recommendations for growth. You'll continuously monitor category trends, evaluate competitive pricing, and ensure merchants maintain Amazon's high standards for delivery and customer experience. The day involves balancing reactive support with proactive business development, all while tracking progress against quarterly targets and updating necessary reports in the CRM system. Participation in external events may apply.
About the team
Our dynamic, multicultural team is dedicated to expanding Amazon's global marketplace by enabling merchants worldwide to reach international customers. Operating at the intersection of technology and international commerce, we help businesses navigate multiple marketplaces, local regulations, and cultural nuances. Our team combines diverse perspectives from professionals across different regions and languages, working together to break down cross-border selling barriers. We pride ourselves on our data-driven approach, entrepreneurial spirit, and commitment to merchant success. Join us in shaping the future of global e-commerce while maintaining Amazon's customer-centric focus.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience prospecting, qualifying, and cold-calling companies
- Experience in procurement, negotiation, sales, consulting, supply chain, product/project management, or marketing
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with pipeline management skills to include utilization of Salesforce or other CRM tools
- Experience and track record of exceeding sales goals
- Experience within e-commerce or Retail fields

Senior/Account Manager (Company Management Services)

Responsible for managing a portfolio of clients to guide them on legal, administrative and corporate activities for their companies. The role-holder is responsible for setting up and maintaining in good standing the corporate and legal structures on behalf of clients. The role holder generates revenue based on value-charging by carrying out legal, administrative and corporate activities, promotes products and services and actively participates in growing the business from existing clients as well as identifying prospective clients through client referrals.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for managing the portfolios of clients and guide them on corporate services inclusive of the setting up and administration of corporate structures and other corporate governance services
  • Work directly with our clients in analyzing and interpreting regulations, procedures, documents relating to our clients’ legal and fiscal opportunities;
  • Actively participating in growing and marketing our business both with existing clients to grow the portfolio but also to develop new business through client referrals.
  • Administering a portfolio of companies, limited partnerships and trusts in accordance with applicable legislation.
  • Monitor, manage, verify and approve the preparation of minutes of shareholder meetings (Ordinary or Extraordinary), and proxies, list of attendance;
  • Coordinate issues concerning taxes, administration, and banking of client companies with the Client Accounting Department.
  • Fully understand the client’s activities and make sure that any action taken is consistent with the company’s activities and purpose within the legal and economic framework for the company.
  • Manage companies and ensure that all information in the client files is correct and up-to-date.
  • Monitor productivity and chargeability on weekly basis and review productivity and performance against targets. to ensure that individual financial and client targets are met.
  • Accurately record chargeable time and value of service using Maconomy in order to facilitate timely invoices.
  • Ensure that all correspondence is signed in conformity with the signatory authority list.
  • Solve payment problems, as well as collection of outstanding invoices;
  • Ensure that “Know Your Customer” rules are adhered to and that client operates within relevant compliance frameworks.
  • Comply with all internal procedures regarding the correct use of automated programs for recording all required client and company data.
  • Maintain up-to-date local office policies and procedures in alignment with local regulations and requirements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to the client and adhere to the regular client contact/ communication guidelines set by the Company, aimed at building personal and long-term relationship with the clients.

OTHER DUTIES

  • Undertake the role of director, trustee, nominee, manager, partner, secretary, authorized signatory or any related position in internal entities or client entities of Amicorp Group, where necessary and required by the Management.
  • Undertake such other duties, related to the position, as may from time to time be agreed with Management.

Qualifications, Skills, and Experience

  • Bachelor or Master Degree in Law, Business, Accounting, Tax or another business related field, additional relevant qualification would be desirable.
  • At least 4 years of relevant working experience within the corporate services business and/or financial services sectors (preferably with international exposure). Additional relevant company secretary or company law qualifications would be highly beneficial;
  • Good understanding of key financial services and industry related legislation. Familiar with international requirements - e.g. CRS, FATCA, BEPS, GAAR, ESR, that affects the clients and entities in target markets.
  • Strong commercial mindset, takes initiative, positive and proactive, dedicated, focused and revenue and target driven.
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Excellent client facing skills. Well-developed spoken and written communication skills and the ability to tailor style to relevant audiences, and successfully liaise with people at different levels. Excellent English language fluency; additional languages preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills, solution driven, highly organized and detail-orientated with good decision making and time management skills. Independent, hands-on and takes accountability to deliver solutions and results.
  • Ability to adapt and work in a smaller, dynamic local team environment; along with being part of a bigger matrix organization. Proven leadership and team player skills, with ambition to excel in the role.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of operational efficiency issues and quality management and control matters.

Ensino superior em enfermagem (completo)

  • Atuação de terça à sábado

Local de atuação: Campo Grande, Rio de Janeiro (RJ)

description:

Essa posição tem como principal responsabilidade a estruturação e fortalecimento da malha de distribuição nacional para o canal On Trade, por meio de parcerias sólidas, com representação exclusiva, definição de KPIs, territórios de atuação e acompanhamento de performance. Também é esperado o desenvolvimento de parcerias com varejistas e clientes estratégicos com foco em distribuição.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time! :)

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias Go-To-Market para a construção da rede ideal de distribuidores e representantes comerciais em todo o Brasil (exceto Sudeste).
  • Realizar o mapeamento, prospecção e gestão de relacionamento com distribuidores e varejistas, promovendo crescimento sustentável da operação.
  • Definir KPIs e obrigações mútuas entre Castas e os parceiros comerciais.
  • Criar programas de excelência e incentivos para estimular a performance dos distribuidores, com foco em resultados e reconhecimento.
  • Monitorar e gerir indicadores de desempenho comercial, como sell-in, sell-out, cobertura de mercado, entre outros.
  • Gerenciar equipes de representantes comerciais como apoio à malha de distribuição, quando necessário.
  • Controlar e acompanhar estoques junto aos distribuidores.
  • Atuar em parceria com os times internos de faturamento, financeiro e contas a pagar, assegurando fluidez na operação.
  • Definir e coordenar parcerias logísticas, visando eficiência, qualidade e redução de custos nas entregas.
  • Colaborar com os Gerentes Regionais de On Trade e Off Trade, garantindo sinergia, suporte e evolução dos mercados atendidos.

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Gestão Comercial, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Comercial, Negócios, Trade Marketing, Gestão de Canais de Distribuição ou Liderança será considerado um diferencial.

Perfil Comportamental:

  • Alta capacidade de negociação e persuasão: essencial para formar e manter parcerias comerciais estratégicas.
  • Visão estratégica: foco em crescimento sustentável, estruturação de redes e análise de oportunidades.
  • Autonomia e senso de dono: perfil proativo, com forte orientação para resultados e tomada de decisão.
  • Habilidade em relacionamento interpessoal: comunicação clara e empática, facilidade em lidar com diferentes perfis e níveis hierárquicos.
  • Organização e disciplina: para gerenciar uma agenda dinâmica com visitas interestaduais e múltiplas frentes de trabalho.
  • Resiliência e flexibilidade: para lidar com ambientes em transformação e com metas desafiadoras.
  • Liderança colaborativa: saber engajar parceiros e times internos em torno de um propósito comum.

Competência técnica:

  • Experiência sólida em gestão comercial com foco em canais de distribuição e/ou varejo, preferencialmente no segmento de bebidas.
  • Conhecimento prático em modelagem e estruturação de redes de distribuição (go-to-market, contratos, exclusividade, território).
  • Domínio de indicadores de desempenho comercial.
  • Vivência em planejamento comercial e definição de KPIs para canais indiretos.
  • Capacidade de elaborar e acompanhar planos de incentivo e programas de excelência para distribuidores.
  • Boa fluência em Excel e ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes em nível nacional.

Join to apply for the Senior UX Designer role at Fastn

Location: Remote (Some overlap hours with Central Time US.)

Language: ENGLISH (MUST HAVE)

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

About Fastn

Fastn is on a mission to revolutionize how SaaS companies connect with their customers' environments. Powered by AI, we provide an embedded integration infrastructure that enables SaaS businesses to build, scale, and manage their integration ecosystems effortlessly.

With Fastn, companies can launch strategic integrations, create their own app marketplace, and unlock new revenue streams by offering seamless connectivity with the tools their customers already use. Our platform goes beyond integrations — it accelerates adoption, drives product-led growth, and delivers smarter, more valuable customer experiences.

If you're passionate about crafting world-class user experiences and solving complex UX challenges in a fast-paced startup environment, Fastn is the place to be.

What You'll Do

As a Senior UX Designer, you'll be the driving force behind user experience design at Fastn. You will lead UX initiatives across our platform, ensuring that every interaction is seamless, intuitive, and empowering for our users. From onboarding to feature discovery, your designs will directly impact product adoption, satisfaction, and retention.

Your Responsibilities

  • Lead UX design across the Fastn platform—from user flows and wireframes to high-fidelity UI and prototypes.
  • Own and evolve Fastn's design system to ensure consistency across all touchpoints.
  • Design intuitive workflows for complex technical tasks, including onboarding, integration setup, and feature adoption.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and interviews to validate and iterate on design decisions.
  • Build and test design prototypes to gather feedback from internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and leadership to align designs with product goals.
  • Champion a user-centered design culture and help establish UX best practices within the company.

What We're Looking For

We're seeking a seasoned UX designer with a track record of building exceptional SaaS experiences and solving complex problems through elegant design. If you thrive in early-stage environments and enjoy shaping design culture from the ground up, we want to talk to you.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • 8 - 10+ years of UX design experience, preferably in SaaS or complex web applications.
  • Early-stage startup experience in the B2B space.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end design work with a focus on user-centered problem-solving.
  • Expertise in Figma and modern design/prototyping tools.
  • Proven ability to translate technical requirements into intuitive interfaces.
  • Experience conducting user research and usability testing.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate design decisions.
  • Experience with component-based design systems.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with low-code/no-code platforms or developer-focused tools.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integration platforms, or technical product UX.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
  • Experience establishing scalable UX processes in high-growth environments.

Why Join Fastn?

  • Shape the UX vision of a category-defining integration platform.
  • Drive meaningful product improvements in a high-impact role.
  • Work closely with passionate product and engineering teams solving real user problems.
  • Opportunity to grow into a design leadership position as the company scales.
  • Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a flexible remote work environment.

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Design, Art/Creative, and Information Technology

Industries

  • Technology, Information and Internet

Company Description

At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects in over 119 offices in 50 countries worldwide.

Our team is dynamic, innovative and client-focused. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity and the quality we deliver. As a result our people get to work on some of the most exciting projects in the world.

Job Description

The Project Manager will take responsibility for end-to-end service delivery, ensuring that client objectives are met through the delivery of an effective service. This includes interfacing with the client and other consultants at all project stages, managing overall project cost, schedule, and budgets, as well as managing general contractors and other directly contracted vendors and consultants.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Analyze, track, and effectively manage critical milestone activities to avoid schedule slip.
  • Run and lead client and other required meetings, presenting updates to the client at all project stages.
  • Identify factors that influence construction costs and monitor and report on this data.
  • Support engineering decisions relating to project cost and budget while design-build changes take place during construction.
  • Review requests for payment.
  • Track and ensure equipment meets the project schedule.
  • Record occurrences that might result in a claim, acting on the client’s behalf.
  • Advocate on behalf of the client during disputes, disagreements, modifications, or change orders.
  • Coordinate and oversee scheduling consultant reviews on the project.
  • Review and approve final invoices, payment applications, and retention payments.
  • Oversee and manage the transfer of building operations to the client, including all close-out documentation and warranties.
  • Collaborative approach, client-facing, able to develop strong relationships, and confidently present to clients and stakeholders.
  • Be assertive and detail-oriented, identifying potential issues early and raising them in the appropriate forum for resolution.
  • Demonstrable record of accomplishment in the delivery of relevant projects.
  • Advanced skills with spreadsheets, report writing, and presentations.
  • Management experience, with the ability to manage and lead a team in delivering a commission and general line management.
  • Manage revenue, team resources, and priorities to ensure that client expectations are met.

Qualifications

  • Above 7 years' experience working in a similar position.
  • Sector experience, more specifically in Mission Critical and Life Science Construction.
  • Degree in Architecture, Engineering, or other construction-related fields.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.
